content.class.grave-child.kit.2.name: 岸滩鞋
content.class.grave-child.name: 墓童

content.class.pallbearer.kit.0.name: 守灵灯
content.class.pallbearer.kit.2.name: 灰色丧服
content.class.pallbearer.name: 抬棺人

content.class.reed-piper.kit.2.name: 笛手兜帽
content.class.reed-piper.name: 芦笛手
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-arrival.opt.0.label: 谁死了？
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-arrival.opt.1.label: 是我们抬她上来的。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-arrival.text: 是你们把她抬上来的。我本该下去迎你们的，我知道。他们把她送来，我就一直守着这堆火，连一眼都没朝坡上望过。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-cannot.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-cannot.text: 因为要是我说“土”，那就是我把她埋进土里；要是我说“水”，那就是我把她还给了那个……对不起。对不起。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-ground.opt.0.label: 守着火吧。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-ground.text: 你说了“土”。谢谢你。我做不到，你说了。我不会假装这是件小事。我会走到火堆边上，看着你们沿着那排把她送过去。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-sedge.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-sedge.text: 塞奇说这片地收走所有人。她说这话的语气，就像说潮水会涨一样。没等谁开口求她，她就已经把土挖开了。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-tide.opt.0.label: 我们带她去。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-tide.text: 你说了“水”。她也会说“水”。我把火拨旺，守着看退潮把她带走。我最远只能走到这儿；她一直知道我这个样子。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-waiting.opt.0.label: 我们在听。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-waiting.text: 塞奇现在在说了。我在下面能听见大半。我想这对我来说就够了。你们上去吧；我们的人该站在板子旁了。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.opt.0.label: 塞奇怎么说？
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.opt.1.label: 为什么不是你？
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.opt.2.label: 土
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.opt.2.tooltip: 把她交给塞奇挖开的土穴。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.opt.3.label: 水
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.text: 他们都在等一个字。按规矩，这个字该由你们来说，因为是你们把她抬上路的。土，还是水。我在这火堆前待了一下午，可我说不出口。
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-wren.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.hallis.hallis-wren.text: 我妹妹。雷恩。她给堡里读水情，整个海岸没人比她读得准，这就是我过不去的坎——既然她最准，那怎么会……
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-arrival.opt.0.label: 她是谁？
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-arrival.opt.1.label: 为什么挖这个坑？
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-arrival.opt.2.label: 我们上去吧。
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-arrival.text: 你们趁退潮上来了。好。土穴已经挖开，挖开的土穴可不看天气。
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-field.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-field.text: 天一亮我就挖开了。两铲沙底下是黏土，撑得住。用不用它，不是我的事。
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-ground.opt.0.label: 我们抬她过去。
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-ground.text: 那就土吧。土穴在那一排的尽头，你们上来时我就站在那儿。天一亮我就把它填上，中午前就平了。
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-rite.opt.0.label: 说吧。
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-rite.text: 你站在木板前。抬的人只需做到这样。站好，手别动。不会太久，这词儿除了这里没人写下来。
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-tide.opt.0.label: 办好了
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-tide.text: 那就水吧。我不去水边。坑今晚留着，明早我来填，填空的。
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-word.opt.0.label: 还没
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-word.text: 仪式说完了。还剩一个词，词不是我的。下到火边，把词带回来。
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-wren.opt.0.label: 回来了
content.dlg.sedge.sedge-wren.text: 阿什洛。她给堡里读潮。她下水那儿的沙软，傍晚我不去走。
content.fx.low-water.oc.greet.0.seq.0.0.narrate: 堡钟响了一声。一声为一人。
content.fx.low-water.oc.greet.0.seq.6.0.narrate: 他们从中午站到现在。他们等的不是潮水，是帮手。
content.fx.the-eulogy.oc.hear-the-rite.0.seq.0.0: 塞奇凭记忆念的。这地里从没人写下过。
content.fx.the-eulogy.oc.hear-the-rite.0.seq.2.0: 她生在水上。给堡里读了三十年潮，潮也读她。
content.fx.the-eulogy.oc.hear-the-rite.0.seq.3.0: 这片地收下每个人。它不收任何人两次。
content.fx.the-ground.oc.to-the-cut.0.seq.1.0.na: 木板放低。塞奇在排头念最后几句，没人催她。
content.fx.the-ground.oc.to-the-cut.0.seq.3.1.na: 坟排多了一人。明早这片地又会平，它会收下她。
content.fx.the-tide.oc.to-the-water.0.seq.1.0.na: 他们蹚水把她抬到潮线处，松了手。水接住她的重量，像从前一样。
content.fx.the-tide.oc.to-the-water.0.seq.3.1.na: 她随退潮走了，像她这辈子每个清晨出门一样。
content.npc.hallis.name: 哈里斯·阿什洛
content.npc.sedge.name: 塞奇

content.obj.low-water.come-up.title: 上到田野
content.obj.low-water.greet.hint: 从你上岸处向上几步，岸边的火堆旁。
content.obj.low-water.greet.title: 与兄弟交谈
content.obj.the-eulogy.hear-the-rite.hint: 从停尸处沿墓排走，到守墓人站着的敞口墓穴那头。
content.obj.the-eulogy.hear-the-rite.title: 听仪式
content.obj.the-ground.to-the-cut.hint: 从停尸处沿墓排走，到墓排尽头的敞口墓穴。
content.obj.the-ground.to-the-cut.title: 抬她到墓穴
content.obj.the-tide.to-the-water.hint: 从岸边火堆往下走，到潮水停住的湿沙处。
content.obj.the-tide.to-the-water.title: 抬她到水边
content.obj.the-word.bring-the-word.hint: 沿墓道回到你上岸处的岸边火堆旁。
content.obj.the-word.bring-the-word.title: 回答兄弟
content.quest.low-water.goal: 低潮时上岸，找到岸边火堆旁的兄弟，再上到田野的停尸处。
content.quest.the-eulogy.goal: 为雷恩·阿什洛站着听守墓人念仪式，让这片地听见她是谁。
content.quest.the-ground.goal: 把她交给守墓人天亮时打开的墓穴，让这片地把她盖上。
content.quest.the-tide.goal: 抬她经过火堆，到潮水留下的线，把她交回她读过的水。
content.quest.the-word.goal: 把那个词带回火堆旁：这片地要土还是要水，选择在你。
content.world.boundary.message: 潮水把你挡回墓地方向。
content.world.outro: 这片地收下给它的，水收下其余的。

source.class.grave-child.kit.2.name: Shore Shoes
source.class.grave-child.name: Grave-Child

source.class.pallbearer.kit.0.name: Wake-Lamp
source.class.pallbearer.kit.2.name: Grey Mourning Coat
source.class.pallbearer.name: Pallbearer

source.class.reed-piper.name: Reed-Piper
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-arrival.opt.0.label: Who died?
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-arrival.opt.1.label: We carried her up.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-arrival.text: You are the ones who carried her up. I should have gone down to meet you, I know that, I have been at this fire since they brought her and I have not once looked up the field.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-cannot.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-cannot.text: Because if I say the ground then I am the one who put her under it, and if I say the water then I am the one who gave her back to the thing that. Sorry. Sorry.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-ground.opt.0.label: Keep the fire.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-ground.text: You said the ground. Thank you. I could not have, and you did, and I am not going to pretend that is a small thing. I will come to the edge of the fire and watch you carry her along the row.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-sedge.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-sedge.text: Sedge says the field takes everyone. She says it the way you would say the tide comes in. She had the ground open before anybody thought to ask her for it.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-tide.opt.0.label: We will bring her.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-tide.text: You said the water. She would have said the water. I am banking the fire and I will watch from it until the ebb has her. That is as far down as I get. She knew that about me.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-waiting.opt.0.label: We are listening.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-waiting.text: Sedge is saying it now. I can hear enough of it from down here. That is close enough for me, I think. Go on up; somebody of ours should be standing at the plank.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.opt.0.label: What does Sedge say?
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.opt.1.label: Why not you?
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.opt.2.label: The ground.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.opt.2.tooltip: Give her to the cut Sedge opened.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.opt.3.label: The tide.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.opt.3.tooltip: Give her back to the water she read.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-word.text: They are waiting on a word, and by the custom the word is yours, because you carried her up the road. Ground or tide. I have had all afternoon at this fire and I cannot.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-wren.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hallis.hallis-wren.text: My sister. Wren. She read the water for the keep and she was better at it than anybody on this coast, which is the part I cannot get past, because if she was better at it then how did it.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-arrival.opt.0.label: Who was she?
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-arrival.opt.1.label: Why the cut?
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-arrival.opt.2.label: We will go up.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-arrival.text: You came up on the low water. Good. The ground is open, and open ground does not wait on weather.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-field.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-field.text: I opened it at first light. Clay under two spades of sand, and it holds. Whether it gets used is not my part.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-ground.opt.0.label: We will carry her.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-ground.text: Ground, then. The cut is at the end of the row, where I was standing when you came up. I will close it at first light and it will be level by noon.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-rite.opt.0.label: Say it.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-rite.text: You stood at the plank. That is all the field asks of the ones who carry. Stand where you are and keep your hands still. It is not long, and it is not written down anywhere but here.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-tide.opt.0.label: It is done.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-tide.text: Water, then. I do not walk to the water. The cut stays open tonight and I will fill it in the morning, empty.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-word.opt.0.label: Nothing yet.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-word.text: The rite is said. What is left is a word, and the word is not mine. Go down to the fire and come back with it.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-wren.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.sedge.sedge-wren.text: Ashlaw. She read the tide for the keep. The sand is soft out where she went in; I would not walk it at dusk.
source.fx.low-water.oc.greet.0.seq.0.0.narrate: The keep bell strikes once. Once is for one.
source.fx.low-water.oc.greet.0.seq.6.0.narrate: They have been standing since noon. They were not waiting for the tide. They were waiting for hands.
source.fx.the-eulogy.oc.hear-the-rite.0.seq.0.0: Sedge speaks it off the inside of her own head. Nobody in this field ever wrote it down.
source.fx.the-eulogy.oc.hear-the-rite.0.seq.2.0: She was born on the water. She read it for the keep thirty years, and it read her back.
source.fx.the-eulogy.oc.hear-the-rite.0.seq.3.0: The field takes everyone. It does not take anyone twice.
source.fx.the-ground.oc.to-the-cut.0.seq.1.0.na: The plank goes down. From the head of the row Sedge says the last of it, and nobody hurries her.
source.fx.the-ground.oc.to-the-cut.0.seq.3.1.na: The row is one longer. By morning the field will be level again, and it will keep her.
source.fx.the-tide.oc.to-the-water.0.seq.1.0.na: They wade her out to the line and let go. The water takes her weight the way it always did.
source.fx.the-tide.oc.to-the-water.0.seq.3.1.na: She goes out on the ebb, the way she went out every morning of her life.
source.npc.hallis.name: Hallis Ashlaw
source.npc.sedge.name: Sedge
source.obj.low-water.come-up.hint: Up the grave road from the fire, to the black banner in the middle of the field.
source.obj.low-water.come-up.title: Come up the field
source.obj.low-water.greet.hint: A few steps up the sand from where you came ashore, at the shore fire.
source.obj.low-water.greet.title: Speak to the brother
source.obj.the-eulogy.hear-the-rite.hint: Along the grave row from the bier, where the warden keeps her post at the head of the open cut.
source.obj.the-eulogy.hear-the-rite.title: Hear the rite
source.obj.the-ground.to-the-cut.hint: Along the grave row from the bier, to the open cut at the row's far end.
source.obj.the-ground.to-the-cut.title: Carry her to the cut
source.obj.the-tide.to-the-water.hint: Down past the shore fire, to the wet sand where the tide stops.
source.obj.the-tide.to-the-water.title: Carry her to the water
source.obj.the-word.bring-the-word.hint: Back down the grave road to the shore fire where you landed.
source.obj.the-word.bring-the-word.title: Answer the brother
source.quest.low-water.goal: Come ashore at low water, find the brother at the shore fire, and go up the field to the bier.
source.quest.the-eulogy.goal: Stand for the rite the warden speaks over Wren Ashlaw, and let the field hear who she was.
source.quest.the-ground.goal: Give her to the cut the warden opened at first light, and let the field close over her.
source.quest.the-tide.goal: Carry her past the fire to the line the tide leaves, and give her back to the water she read.
source.quest.the-word.goal: Carry the word back down to the fire: the field wants the ground or the water, and the choice is yours.
source.world.boundary.message: The tide turns you back toward the graves.
source.world.outro: The field keeps what it is given, and the water keeps the rest.
source.world.title: The Wake
